body: Just finished setting up our monorepo workspaces structure. Having shared/types, shared/tokens, and shared/hooks compiling on the fly in apps/web is incredibly smooth! Highly recommend adopting this setup for any multi-app React frameworks.

comments.body: It makes UI development so fast! Designing tokens once in CSS HSL variables and sharing them across apps is the dream.
